handoff.salientSummary: Ran foundation scrutiny validator gate using commands from .factory/services.yaml. Test suite passed, but typecheck and lint failed with concrete diagnostics, so review subagents and synthesis were intentionally skipped per scrutiny-validator procedure.
handoff.whatWasImplemented: Invoked the scrutiny-validator skill, loaded mission context (mission, validation contract, features, AGENTS, services manifest), identified completed foundation implementation features, and executed the validator gate commands (`bun test --timeout 120000`, `bun run check`, `bun run lint`) to determine whether code review fan-out could proceed.
handoff.whatWasLeftUndone: Did not spawn `scrutiny-feature-reviewer` subagents and did not produce `.factory/validation/foundation/scrutiny/synthesis.json` because validator gate failed (typecheck and lint), which is a blocking stop condition for this validator.
